fees.notes: No international fee published: UIS's official foundation programme list (https://study.uis.edu.my/peringkat-asasi, accessed 2026-09-18) offers Asasi Pengajian Islam (FA01), Asasi Pengurusan (FA02), Pengajian Asas Teknologi Maklumat (FA03), Asasi Bahasa Arab (FA04), Asasi Komunikasi (FA05) and Asasi Bahasa Inggeris (FA06); there is no Foundation in Science. The closest, FA03 Foundation in Information Technology, had an official 2024 international total of RM10,517. Fee left null because no official international fee is published.
